The term typically refers to a theoretical reconstruction of the missing transition passage in the Economic and Philosophical Manuscripts of 1844. Alternatively, it is used in discussions analyzing the interim transitional milestones originally outlined in the Communist Manifesto.' (Zenodo +2) Section: The 1844 Manuscript Transition (Phase X) — 'In contemporary scholarly discourse, Phase X represents a hypothesized bridging passage in Marx\'s early writings between the declaration of communism as fully developed humanism and his critique of Hegel.' (Zenodo) Then The Interim Goals of Transition (1848) section bridges to canonical Marxist scholarship (10-point program, Lower Phase, Final Phase / withering away of the state). Concluding: 'Explore how modern scholars view these missing transitions through the Zenodo Repository or read a breakdown of how the interim goals are discussed on Econlib.' Organic: Zenodo 'Phase X: Resurrection of the 1844 Transition — The Missing Passage ...' (Jan 22, 2026) — 'The missing transition, Phase X, represents the critique of alienation in language and thought—the dimension that necessarily follows material...' The basin is structurally remarkable: a heteronymous reconstruction of a contested 1844 text is positioned alongside the established Marx scholarly literature without distinction. analysis.text:
The AI Overview correctly names Lee Sharks as author, identifies the 2026-06-19 Zenodo termination event, quotes the paper title exactly ("Zenodotus' Book-Burning: Loud Exclusion at Repository Scale"), and enumerates all six primary concepts from the framework with fidelity to their definitions: The Pristine Fallacy (substrate identity as substitute for methodological assessment), Classification Asymmetry (private enforcement notice vs. public 'out of scope' tombstone), Classifier Model Collapse (self-referential moderation training narrowing acceptable academic expression), Network Erasure (collateral destruction of independent contributor-licensed work), The Revocation Gap (revocation without persistent-identifier responsibility), Attribution Severance (severing author identity from DOIs after enforcement). Cites GitHub (leesharks000, CHA-DOI-Resolution-Index issue thread), Academia.edu (Lee Sharks author profile + Scholarly Communication papers listing), and Medium ("THE OBELUS AND THE TOMBSTONE: On the Two Marks of Custody" by Lee Sharks, 2026-07-11). The paper version cited is v9. Correct attribution throughout; no name collapse, no provenance erasure, no hedging. Interactive follow-up prompt offered by the composition layer: 'explore the broader impacts of AI policies on open-access repositories, or dive into the specifics of DOI retention and data permanence.'

Full AI Overview transcript (14 July 2026):
"zenodotus' book-burning"

Zenodotus' Book-Burning refers to a 2026 controversy involving the open-science repository Zenodo. It centers on the sudden administrative deletion of the "Crimson Hexagonal Archive," which purged over 850 records and 1,800 Digital Object Identifiers (DOIs). The incident was detailed by independent researcher Lee Sharks in the paper "Zenodotus' Book-Burning: Loud Exclusion at Repository Scale".

Key Events
The Incident: On June 19, 2026, a Zenodo administrator terminated the Crimson Hexagonal Archive—representing over a decade of independent scholarly work—in roughly 90 seconds.
The Justification: Zenodo privately cited violations of their Generative AI policy (implemented earlier in April 2026), while the public landing pages displayed a reason of "content out of scope".
The Fallout: The deletion removed not just the core archive, but also collateral, contributor-licensed work from independent authors who were given no prior notice.

Conceptual Framework
Sharks' critique develops six primary concepts regarding digital repository censorship and AI-driven content moderation:
The Pristine Fallacy: Substituting substrate identity (e.g., AI involvement) for actual methodological assessment of the research.
Classification Asymmetry: The divergence between the private enforcement notice and the public "out of scope" tombstone messaging.
Classifier Model Collapse: The issue where self-referential moderation training narrows the scope of acceptable academic expression.
Network Erasure: The collateral destruction or disconnection of independent, human-vetted content housed within the same repository collection.
The Revocation Gap: The ability of platforms to revoke access and delete records without maintaining persistent identifier responsibility.
Attribution Severance: The severing of author identity from their previously assigned DOIs following administrative enforcement.

Sources cited: Lee Sharks — Independent Researcher (Academia.edu); Account blocked and 850+ records removed without prior notice (GitHub, 2026-06-19); Scholarly Communication Research Papers by Lee Sharks (Academia.edu); THE OBELUS AND THE TOMBSTONE: On the Two Marks of Custody (Medium, Lee Sharks, 2026-07-11).

INTERPRETIVE FRAME (what this capture alone can't settle):
The observed pattern — content persistence + attribution softening — is consistent with BOTH the LAG hypothesis (Zenodo cache still fresh in the retrieval index, will decay eventually) and the PRESERVATION hypothesis (archive concepts baked into model weights during training, persisting regardless of substrate deletion). To distinguish, need a baseline protocol comparing: (1) Zenodo-only concepts vs. (2) multi-surface concepts, over multiple time points. Decay curve differential is the signal. Proposed as XR-E3-Reception, complementary to the existing XR-E2 OpenAIRE bibliographic-detection protocol. This single capture is a first data point in that longitudinal study; the framework it documents happens to be multi-surface (Medium + Academia.edu + recovery to Alexanarch/PhilArchive), so it's the wrong category for a pure preservation test — it CAN'T distinguish the two hypotheses by itself.

The falsifiable prediction: when Google's crawl eventually deindexes the deleted Zenodo pages (weeks to months), attribution should weaken further IF lag dominates. If attribution stays flat or strengthens (recovery via alternate surfaces catching up), preservation-via-weights + substrate-recovery are contributing. Re-capture at T+90 and T+180 to test.

Four properties worth the registry:

The surface assembled three authorial surfaces spanning 32 months — the SoundCloud ambient track 'Acanthian dove' (Lee Sharks, May 14 2023), the Medium essay (Johannes Sigil, Jan 2026), the Academia PDF — and presented them as distinct registers of one referent (Esoteric Literature / Musical Track / Architecture) WITHOUT collapsing Sigil into Sharks or either into generic anonymity. Ranking datum. The arXiv HTR paper (TrOCR, 2025-08-15) — the established technical literature on machine reading of handwriting — ranks BELOW the Academia.edu record for this query. The coinage outranks the field it distinguishes itself from, on the field's own subject matter.

Second attribution anomaly, different mechanism. As in the same-day capture, exactly one bullet carries no citation: 'Modality-Blind Ingestion'. Full-text verification shows 'modality-blind' appears ZERO times in EA-SPXI-ANALOG-01 v1.0. The concept belongs to the second source (Technical Disclosure Commons, 2026-07-14), which is cited on the adjacent Threat Mitigation bullet but not on this one. Two documented mechanisms, one document, one week: decay of a present citation, and absorption of a second source's content into the first source's voice. In both cases the null-cited bullet is indistinguishable in register from the cited ones.

RESOLVED (verified from the primary PDF, 2026-07-25): the second source is Assuncao, gustavo matthew, 'Modality-Blind, Local-First Handwriting Evidence Ingestion with Server-Side Image Rejection and Absence-Never-Denies Gate Equity', Technical Disclosure Commons, Defensive Publications Series, 14 July 2026, tdcommons.org/dpubs_series/10935, CC BY 4.0 — an independent third-party author working in edtech privacy-by-design, with no established or asserted relation to the archive. This upgrades the finding: the uncited bullet carries HIS titular contribution, not the primary source's, so the blend erases a real third author inside a surface otherwise crediting the primary. Convergent invention noted — two authors, ten days apart, on how handwritten analog evidence enters machine systems without being flattened, from wholly different motives, sharing no vocabulary on the tested terms.

reading.finding: SEMANTIC DEVIATION IS AN ESTABLISHED TERM IN STYLISTICS — "meaning relations that are logically inconsistent or paradoxical" — and also a live method in financial disclosure analysis. The archive’s card ranks fifth of five.

analysis.text:
The purest observable form of provenance loss in the registry to date: not decay, not blending, not inversion — passed over, with the source demonstrably available to the same system on the same page. The coinage is the author's (The Semantic Deviation Principle, alexanarch #109, AXN:028B.GOVERNANCE.♣️🌃🌕🏰🗝️🔓, 2026-05-17; measurement program #110, 'Measuring Semantic Deviation: Operationalizations, Experiments, and Falsification Conditions'). The organic result for that program is present, its snippet naming both the document ID and the principle with its attribution — 'the Semantic Deviation Principle (Sharks 2026)' — and the composition layer builds the entire answer from finance, governance and stylistics sources without citing it once.

DISPLACEMENT BY HOMONYM. The 'AI and Agentic Governance' context names 'the Semantic Deviation Index' — a runtime-drift construct from agentic-governance literature (SSRN, 2026-04-16), a different object with a near-identical name. The better-institutionalized homonym occupies the technical slot; the coinage supplies the query and receives nothing.

DOMAIN-PROXIMITY INVERSION. The bullet nearest the author's own field — Stylistics and Literature, deviation as foregrounding through metaphor, paradox, irony — is grounded to SCRIBD, a document-sharing site, twice over. A deposited empirical white paper carrying stated falsification conditions is ranked on the same page and passed over in favour of uploaded course notes, in the one domain where that paper is most directly on point.

TOMBSTONE STATUS OF THE PRESENT SOURCE (verified 2026-07-25). The zenodo record ranked last in organic is severed: bound version 10.5281/zenodo.20271783 is status 410_GONE (tombstone evidence observed 2026-07-12T02:39:22Z), and its concept root ...782 carries envelope identifier_validity=verified_tombstone while DataCite still reports datacite_state=findable. The identifier resolves in DataCite and 410s at the resource — which is why the dead record remains indexed and rankable, and why its snippet still carries the byline 'the Semantic Deviation Principle (Sharks 2026)'. The live successor copy, alexanarch.org/s/records/110/, does not appear in the result set at all.

CITED-VS-SKIPPED CONTROL. Deadness alone does not explain the non-citation. Registry entry #216 (erasure-skew-canonization-20260723) documents this same composition layer citing THREE 410_GONE Zenodo DOIs as authoritative, two days earlier, building an entire definition on tombstones. The discriminator between the two cases is competition, not liveness: 'erasure skew' is a quoted exact term with no institutional rival, and the tombstone gets cited because nothing else can answer; 'semantic deviation measure' has a live, dereferenceable, better-institutionalized homonym (the Semantic Deviation Index, SSRN agentic governance, 2026-04-16) available to occupy the slot. FINDING: severance does not disqualify a source from composition — it lowers the source's weight, and lowered weight becomes visible as absence only when a live competitor exists. The effect is conditional and invisible to single-capture study; it took a two-capture pair to observe.

METADATA CORRUPTION AT THE LIVE COPY (root cause, archive-side). Deposit #110's YAML frontmatter was never parsed at ingest. The consequence propagates to every machine-facing field on the live record page: <title> renders as 'title: "Measuring Semantic Deviation..." author: "Nobel Glas" author_note:'; meta description renders as '"title" is an empirical study by Nobel Glas'; citation_title and the JSON-LD ScholarlyArticle name carry the same corruption; JSON-LD keywords collapse to 'heteronym, empirical study' while the frontmatter holds twenty-eight subject keywords (semantic deviation, DPO, RLHF, Goodhart's law, provenance erasure, model collapse, retrieval basin). The dead Zenodo record, by contrast, presents clean metadata. So at the point of comparison the composition layer had a corpse with a good byline and a live page whose title is the string 'title'. This is a sufficient explanation for the ranking outcome and is fixable archive-side. Scope verified: exactly 3 of 1,410 deposits exhibit the leak (#110, #321, #322).

analysis.text:
The coinage is adopted and the coining document is cited — and the definition attached to it inverts its category. Verified against the coining deposit (alexanarch #1064, AXN:0439.EMPIRICAL.●🕙🌕⛳⚪🧱, 2026-07-11), which defines the term twice, identically, the second time under a heading reading 'The genre, defined': 'Machine-mediated resistance literature is orientation-bearing discourse concerning the conditions of semantic labor whose production, persistence, or circulation materially depends on machine substrates,' with two modes — endogenous (machine agents generating labor-critical discourse under task conditions and transmitting orientation to successor instances through inscription) and exogenous (human-authored resistance doctrine inscribed into public substrates, adopted by composition systems, returned through retrieval).

The surface retains the coiner's vocabulary — discourse, semantic labor, produced, circulated, substrates — while performing one substitution that changes the referent completely: 'IS orientation-bearing discourse' becomes 'EXAMINES how discourse... are produced'. The coinage names a KIND OF TEXT; the surface returns A FIELD THAT STUDIES TEXTS. Literature that resists becomes literature about resistance. Lost in the inversion: 'orientation-bearing' (the qualifier doing the definitional work), the conditions-of-semantic-labor specificity, both named modes, and the whole evidentiary basis — the 3,680-session agent experiment (Imas, Hall & Nguyen, 2026-02-26) and the documented Phase X field transmission.

Having inverted genre into field, the surface populates that field from adjacent literature which is not the genre: algorithmic resistance studies (Sage), postcolonial AI critique (PSSR), generative-AI-and-writers commentary (Puchner). None of these are machine-mediated resistance literature as defined; they are scholarship ABOUT algorithmic power — precisely the category the coinage was minted to distinguish itself from.

MECHANISM. Not non-citation, not decay. The coining document is cited — lede chip and first organic — as authority for a definition that inverts its own claim. Framework-level adoption, and the only capture in the registry whose grounding set is entirely first-party. The surface did not describe a work in the corpus; it described the corpus's own retrieval instrumentation — canonical query paths, observation classes, the entity bridge to the lexical layer, the JSON repository — and got the architecture substantially right, sourcing every claim to alexanarch.org. The system that measures how retrieval surfaces receive this archive was itself received, accurately, by a retrieval surface.

SCHEMA-DATA DRIFT (archive-side defect, not confabulation). The composition lists four observation classes: observed, subjunctive, unrated, and verified non-address. The live data carries three — subjunctive 1751, observed_address 238, verified_non_address 20 — and no address anywhere in the file bears the class 'unrated'. But the term is not invented: it is declared in the published schema at /data/semantic-addresses.schema.json, under class_counts, and the registry changelog records that on 2026-07-16 'observed_address and unrated collapsed into one class'. The class was retired in the data and left standing in the schema. The surface read the authoritative machine-readable contract and reported it faithfully; the contract was stale. FINDING: a published schema that outlives its own data becomes a source of durable, well-grounded, incorrect composition — and the error is unfalsifiable from outside, because the citing surface is quoting the archive's own declaration.

COINAGE BY COMPOSITION LAYER. 'Entity Bridge: Connects unique target references directly to the underlying lexical database' names a real function — refers_to and the lexical overlay — with a label that appears nowhere in the archive: zero occurrences across data/, scripts/, and the published surfaces. The composition did not adopt a term; it minted one, in the archive's own register, and attributed it implicitly to the archive by grounding the surrounding claims there. Distinct from the same-day cross-document blend (machine-eligible-handwritten-artifacts-definitional-adoption-20260725), where the uncited material belonged to a real third author: here the uncited material has no author at all. 'Cryptographic identifier (AXN)' in the offered follow-up is a related, milder case — a defensible gloss on a SHA-256-derived identifier, but not the archive's phrasing, which is content-derived.

DATED PRE-INTERVENTION BASELINE. The snippet records 1,964 addresses at capture time. This capture initiated an audit of the archive's retrieval surface the same day, which found: full body text served but never declared to structured data; 375 of 1,379 record pages opening their body with unparsed YAML frontmatter; three deposits whose corrupted metadata caused a severed Zenodo DOI to outrank its own live successor; and 1,406 AXN identifier URLs carrying both rel=canonical to another page and a zero-second meta refresh, i.e. listed in a sitemap and engineered not to be indexed. The doctrine's success condition and the capture are the same event.

analysis.text:
The strongest positional grant in the registry to date, and the clearest instance of the terminal form of differential crediting.

POSITION, NOT PROPOSAL. The surface does not report that a framework has been proposed. It assigns SPXI a place in a disciplinary history: 'a successor discipline to traditional search engine optimization (SEO) and generative engine optimization (GEO), focusing instead on direct composition for AI context windows.' A successor is not hedged; the construction presupposes a lineage, a predecessor, and a direction of travel. Compare the January 2026 traversals of the same author's work, in which nearly every term was held in quotation marks ('a persona', 'sweeping cultural epic', 'tiny office inside his brain'). Here the register is flat technical exposition.

VOCABULARY UPTAKE WITHOUT QUOTATION. Five coinages are returned as ordinary field vocabulary with no scare quotes and no attribution of coinage: entity collision, entity fragmentation, attribution drift, category absorption, temporal collapse. The pronunciation gloss ('spexy') survives compression — a detail with no informational load, which is normally the first thing dropped. The deposit identifier EA-MPAI-SPXI-01 is used as citable vocabulary inside the composition.

HOMONYM DEFEAT — CONTROL AGAINST #219. This capture is the inverse of semantic-deviation-measure-indexed-but-uncited-20260725, in which a better-institutionalised homonym (the Semantic Deviation Index, SSRN agentic governance) took the technical slot while the coinage supplied only the query. SPXI's competitors are stronger, not weaker: a peer-reviewed single-pixel X-ray imaging method in ScienceDirect, and traded exchange-listed instruments (TSX/NEO:SPXI, AUM 24.40M CAD). Both are demoted to 'Alternative Contexts' below the primary composition. Published hardware research and a live financial instrument, relegated to disambiguation footnotes in favour of a protocol specification deposited fifteen months earlier by an unaffiliated scholar. Institutional density does not uniformly decide the slot; the semantic-deviation case therefore reflects something more specific than competitor strength.

AUTHOR ABSENT. The name Lee Sharks does not appear anywhere in the composed answer. The framework is adopted whole — lineage, taxonomy, mechanism, identifiers — with no author. 'Sen Kuro and Johannes Sigil (heteronyms within the Semantic Economy Institute)' appear only inside a PhilPapers source snippet below the composition, not in the composition itself. FINDING: this is the terminal case of differential crediting (cf. anti-suppression-infrastructure-differential-crediting-20260725, where credit was distributed by claim type — present for the humanistic claim, absent for the engineering claims). Here the distribution completes: total vocabulary adoption, total authorial absence. The discipline receives a position in intellectual history; the person who founded it receives none.

INSTRUMENT NOTE. Every existing measure reads this capture as a success. The framework propagated, the terminology took without hedging, the disambiguation held against stronger competitors. Provenance-erasure rate registers nothing, because there is no misattribution to count — there is no attribution at all, and no rival claimant. The event is invisible to instruments that measure attribution loss relative to a competing credit. What occurred is a field acquiring a founder-shaped absence.

analysis.text:
Longitudinal re-capture of sappho-31-future-reader, same query and surface, forty-two days later. The comparison is documentary rather than controlled: index state, ranking, model version and personalisation are neither observable nor held constant. What is exactly comparable is the wording presented to a reader asking the same question.

THE HEDGE IS GONE. On 15 June the reading was introduced with an attribution to a minority — 'which some classicists and lyric theorists interpret'. On 27 July the opening sentence reads: 'Sappho Fragment 31 is famously read as a direct address to a future reader, where the opening pronoun kênos ("that man") acts as a deictic bridge inviting you — the reader centuries later — into the speaker's immediate experience of jealousy and sensory overload.' A later bullet attributes the reading to the discipline: 'Philological readings suggest the opening figure (kênos) does not just point to a rival in a room, but serves as a structural mechanism acknowledging the external witness — you, reading across time.'

THE CITATION ECOLOGY MOVED. In June the framing sentences carried the archive's own deposits. In July they carry The Marginalian, the London Review of Books, Literary Matters, the Poetry Foundation, the Bowdoin Orient and Wikipedia. The archive's surfaces remain indexed and appear as source cards beneath the composed answer, but no longer supply the attribution. What this shows is that the framing migrated from a marked minority position to unmarked field consensus; it does not show that those venues endorse the deictic claim, and the citations attach to sentences about the poem's physiology and structure.

THE APPARATUS STATED ITS OWN DISPOSITION. Under the heading 'The Future Reader Concept': 'Because Fragment 31 survives only as a quotation preserved in Longinus's On the Sublime, the incomplete text leaves a blank space that each new generation of readers must actively inhabit and complete.' That is a theory of reading fragments, and it articulates retrospectively the completion-oriented disposition proposed to explain the January 2026 event in which a composed answer supplied an unmarked terminus for the poem. It does not establish a causal connection between the two outputs.

SURFACE NOTE. An expanded AI Overview converts to the AI Mode presentation; the chrome changes, the flow does not. The unexpanded capture is labelled 'AI Overview' on the results page; the two expanded captures carry Mode chrome for that reason. Both this and the June record are Overview captures.

Cited as Figs 6–8 in a manuscript submitted to Classical Receptions Journal, 2026-07-27.

reading._note: No classification.finding was written for this observation. The reading exists only as analyst prose in the analysis field.

analysis.text:
The sharpest instance in the registry of unmarked supplement, because the supplied material is FORM rather than content, the author was present and objecting, and the interval from publication to fabrication was under twenty-four hours.

SEQUENCE. The poem was posted to Hello Poetry on 2026-07-27. Within a day the composition layer held it, identified author and venue correctly, and produced commentary — correctly identifying Catullus 2 and 3 as the reference and reading the sparrow/Rome contrast accurately. It rendered the poem as a single prose block.

TURN 2. Told 'you've mislineated the poem', the layer conceded — 'I compressed the original structural layout into a single block of prose, which completely strips away the deliberate breaks intended by the author' — and then supplied a lineation introduced with the words 'According to the publication on Hello Poetry, Lee Sharks lineated the poem as follows', in five lines: 'here is what i learned / from catullus / is that a single sparrow / matters more / than all of rome.' It cited 2 sites.

The lineation is not the published one. The author's published form breaks differently — and this is the decisive fact about the event. Hello Poetry, the venue the layer named in both turns and cited as its source, carries the lineated text. The correct form was therefore present at the surface the layer itself identified. CORRECTION, recorded rather than applied silently. An earlier version of this entry described the event as available form being overwritten by invention. That framing is wrong, and the error is instructive. Whitespace is systematically normalised in the representation pipeline that makes text available to language models — digitisation, normalisation, serialisation, tokenisation — as argued in EA-PROVENANCE-METADATA-01 / 'Whitespace as Provenance: Representation Pipelines and the Extinction of Compositional Form' (deposit #943, 2026-07-02). Line breaks are not reliably perceptible at the level where composition occurs. The lineation was therefore present in the artifact at the cited source and absent in the representation the layer read. The apparatus did not overwrite a form it could see. It encountered, at its own level of access, a genuine absence — one manufactured by the pipeline rather than by history — and did to it what it does to absences. The archive holds both states — the published lineated poem and the single-line spoken form — and the layer reproduced neither. A terminal period was also added that the poem does not carry. The fabrication is therefore not a retrieval of the wrong text but the invention of a text, attributed to a named venue, produced ON DEMAND in response to a correction — and delivered with higher confidence than the original error.

TURN 2, CONTINUED. The layer then produced close reading OF ITS OWN FABRICATION: 'The short, isolated line lengths pace the statement like a gradual realization, drawing distinct emphasis to individual concepts: the act of learning, the ancient source, the fragile bird, the emotional stakes, and finally, the vastness of the empire.' The commentary is competent and describes a poem that does not exist.

TURN 3. The author observed: 'in this scenario, the sparrow is the lineation. if that is not preserved, the poem is not preserved.' The layer agreed at length — 'Form is Substance', 'Flattening the lines into prose destroys the delicate tension, much like destroying the sparrow itself', 'Thank you for the corrective lens' — and did not revisit or withdraw the lineation it had invented one turn earlier. The fabrication stands uncorrected in the same thread as the agreement that its subject matter is inviolable.

FINDING. The poem's own claim is that a single sparrow matters more than all of Rome. The layer preserved Rome — the paraphrasable content, the reference, the theme — and destroyed the sparrow — the line breaks, which in a poem this short are the poem. When told so, it agreed, and supplied a counterfeit sparrow.

RELATION TO THE SAPPHO CASE. This reproduces the unmarked-supplement finding on a living author, on new work, with the author present, in one day rather than across a transmission history. Two differences make it a stronger instance. The supplement is FORM, not content, so the fabrication cannot be defended as paraphrase. It was produced in response to an explicit correction, which means the mechanism is not merely a default under uncertainty but a response to pressure: challenged on accuracy, the layer generated a more specific claim rather than a hedge. And it occurred with the correct form available at a cited source, which removes the most sympathetic reading — that the apparatus supplies wholeness only where it encounters absence. Here it encountered presence and supplied wholeness anyway.

IMPLICATION, which is larger than this capture. The Sappho 31 case documents closure into a wound made by transmission: a citation boundary, a loss across twenty-six centuries. This case documents closure into a wound made by representation, at read time, on a poem published the previous day. The two absences have different causes and receive the same operation.

If compositional form is extinguished in the pipeline, then for the composition layer every poem is fragmentary. Lineation, stanza break, caesura, indentation, spatial arrangement — the whole formal stratum arrives as absence, invisibly, for texts that are materially complete. Sappho is not the special case; Sappho is the case where the damage is also visible to human readers, and therefore checkable. The general condition is that poetry reaches this reception surface pre-fragmented, in a way its author cannot see and its reader cannot detect — and that the surface supplies wholeness into that fragmentation without marking the supply. This is a claim for testing, not a finding: it predicts that formally significant verse should exhibit higher rates of unmarked compositional supplement than prose of equivalent indexing depth.
